records.source: One bad ingredient can ruin the whole soup...$0
records.translation: Maaaring sirain ng isang di-magandang sangkap ang buong sabaw...$0

records.source: You say it's raining up above? *gasp*#$e#Rain... It's almost mythical to us. Some of us live our entire lives without ever experiencing it.
records.translation: Sabi mo, umuulan sa itaas? *napasinghap*#$e#Ulan... halos alamat lang iyon sa amin. Ang ilan sa amin ay nabubuhay nang hindi iyon nararanasan kailanman.

records.source: In the dark depths of the sea lie many mysteries, waiting to be uncovered.$0
records.translation: Sa madidilim na kailaliman ng dagat, maraming hiwagang naghihintay na matuklasan.$0

records.source: *pant*... *pant*... ahhhh, I can't wait for a bowl of piping hot soup...$h
records.translation: *hingal*... *hingal*... ahhhh, sabik na ako sa isang mangkok ng napakainit na sabaw...$h

records.source: I heard it's raining back home. Is that why you came here?$h#$e#I kind of miss the rain, actually...$s
records.translation: Narinig kong umuulan sa inyo. Iyon ba ang dahilan kung bakit ka pumunta rito?$h#$e#Sa totoo lang, medyo hinahanap-hanap ko rin ang ulan...$s

records.source: B...But... Do I have to eat it?$2
records.translation: P...Pero... Kailangan ko ba talagang kainin iyon?$2

records.source: Why can't I go play by the tide pools?$s
records.translation: Bakit hindi ako maaaring maglaro sa Mga Lawa-lawa sa Kati?$s

records.source: Don't worry, I'll be back for the soup... I'm just enjoying a tender moment with me pipe!$3
records.translation: Huwag kang mag-alala, babalik ako para sa sabaw... Tinatamasa ko lang ang isang magiliw na sandali kasama ang aking pipa!$3

records.source: My home is that way, across the ocean. It feels so close, but so far away.$0#$e#I hope my friends are doing well.$0
records.translation: Naroon ang tahanan ko, sa kabila ng karagatan. Parang napakalapit, pero napakalayo.$0#$e#Sana maayos ang mga kaibigan ko.$0
